import numpy as np, os,re,json
from scipy.ndimage import label
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for p in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    i=np.array(G[p+' input']); o=np.array(G[p+' output'])
    chg=(i==2)&(i!=o); unm=(i==2)&(o==2)
    h,w=i.shape
    lab,n=label(chg); labu,mu=label(unm)
    print('===',p,'changed comps:',n,'unchanged comps:',mu)
    feats=[]
    for cid in range(1,n+1):
        rs,cs=np.where(lab==cid); 
        rr,c0,c1=rs.min(),rs.max(),cs.min(); b=c1-c0+1
        # dist to nearest 1 in input
        ones=np.argwhere(i==1)
        dist=np.min(np.abs(ones[:,None]-[rr,cs]))  # manhattan over rows&cols? use both dims properly
        dist=np.min([abs(ones[k,0]-rr)+abs(ones[k,1]-c0) for k in range(len(ones))],default=1e9)
        feats.append({'size':len(rs),'shape':(b,rr,c0),'rspan':(rr,rs.max()),'cspan':(c0,c1),'dist1':dist})
    for cid in range(1,mu+1):
        rs,cs=np.where(labu==cid)
        rr,c0,c1=rs.min(),rs.max(),cs.min(); b=c1-c0+1
        ones=np.argwhere(i==1)
        dist=min([abs(ones[k,0]-rr)+abs(ones[k,1]-c0) for k in range(len(ones))] if len(ones) else [1e9],[0])
        feats.append({'size':len(rs),'tag':'U','shape':(b,rr,c0),'rspan':(rr,rs.max()),'cspan':(c0,c1),'dist1':dist,'type':'U'})
    for f in sorted(feats,key=lambda x:(x['tag'] or 'C')):
